blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur—Holding placards bearing messages such as “Reject Pax Silica” and “Trump Out,” students from various schools gathered outside the University of Northern Philippines (UNP) in Vigan City on Tuesday, Nov. 17, to protest the proposed US-led initiative and the visit of US President Donald Trump.
